data.title: 堀京子 · 冬夜被炉里的橘子
data.description: 客厅被炉，她半个身子缩在被炉里剥橘子，头发放下来散在肩上；电视的光映在她脸上，是忙碌一天后难得的懒散时刻。
data.action: 披散头发缩进被炉，悠闲剥开一只橘子。
data.promptProse: Kyouko Hori rests half tucked into the living-room kotatsu, peeling a mandarin after the day's work. Her chestnut hair hangs loose over a warm cream sweater, dark trousers sheltered under the blanket. The horizontal medium view includes the peel gathering on the tabletop and the sofa behind. Television light shifts softly across her relaxed face and orange skin, with faint table-edge shadows receding into the otherwise quiet room.
